    results = []
    for case in test_cases:
        n = case[0]
        moments = case[1:]
        valid = True
        
        for i in range(1, n):
            p_prev, c_prev = moments[i-1]
            p_curr, c_curr = moments[i]
            
            if p_curr < p_prev or c_curr < c_prev or c_curr > p_curr or (p_curr - p_prev) < (c_curr - c_prev):
                valid = False
                break
        
        if valid:
            results.append("YES")

            results.append("NO")

            c = int(data[index + 1])
            moments.append((p, c))
            index += 2
        test_cases.append((n, moments))
    
    results = check_records(test_cases)
    for result in results:
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
